server-address.name: Server Address
server-address.description: Server address to connect to for versus mode

auto-reconnect.name: Auto Reconnect
auto-reconnect.description: Automatically reconnect if connection is lost mid-match

sync-interval-ms.name: Sync Interval (ms)
sync-interval-ms.description: How often state sync packets are sent. Lower = smoother but more bandwidth

show-opponent-icon.name: Show Opponent Icon
show-opponent-icon.description: Show the opponent's player icon during matches

enable-anticheat-logs.name: Log Anti-Cheat
enable-anticheat-logs.description: Log anti-cheat rejections and flagged events (debug only)

enable-network-logs.name: Log Network Packets
enable-network-logs.description: Log detailed sent/received packets (may slow down the game)
